subject.title: Feature Request: Cross-platform migration tool (migrate export/import)

question: Should OpenClaw core own automated same-product archive import/restore, or should core stay limited to safer backup export, platform conversion, verification, and manual restore guidance?
rationale: The answer controls CLI namespace, archive trust, secret/session portability, destructive write behavior, and whether overlapping backup or plugin work should proceed in core.

options.title: Scope Minimal Native Import
options.body: Define a preview-first core export/import lifecycle with canonical target validation, secret/session policy, rollback/conflict handling, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Prefer Backup Convert And Manual Restore
options.body: Keep automated restore out of core for now while improving backup output targeting, verification, conversion, and migration docs.

options.title: Route Optional Pieces To Plugins
options.body: Narrow core to missing APIs and let plugin or ClawHub packages own cloud, scheduled, encrypted, or workspace-specific migration flows.

recommendation.title: Scope Minimal Native Import
recommendation.body: Define a preview-first core export/import lifecycle with canonical target validation, secret/session policy, rollback/conflict handling, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The related implementation discussion already centers on backup overlap and restore security boundaries, where gumadeiras provided the clearest maintainer signal.
